families.ground_truth_rule: the Code4rena verdict for the finding
a root cause stated by a source, or an invariant stated by a source; unscorable otherwise
an attacker model derived from the cited source or reported by the audit; unknown is a valid answer
a PoC body published in the report
an executed run recorded by the pipeline
an exploit executed at the audited revision, with the security property observed to be violated
an attempted exploit executed at the audited revision
the same exploit executed against the vulnerable AND the fixed revision
the ecosystem the sources publish, or the ingest rule from the code the report cites; observed_fact when every source is a machine-read security advisory
the severity recorded for the record and the attribution recorded with it; partial when a rating exists without an attribution, unlabeled when no source publishes a rating
the L0-L6 level the executed run earned and its outcome, read from the record's own experiment block
the identity a quoted source sentence states, plus the sentence verbatim; unknown where no source says
the record_class assigned by the ingest rule, with its evidence type taken from who states the class
tier, evidence origin, content licence and redistribution rights per source, under the published tier rules
the closed evidence vocabulary applied per field, the record's strongest and weakest evidence, and the published quality rubric applied to observations

ground_truth_rules.A_vulnerability_detection: the Code4rena verdict for the finding
ground_truth_rules.B_root_cause_reasoning: a root cause stated by a source, or an invariant stated by a source; unscorable otherwise
ground_truth_rules.C_attacker_reasoning: an attacker model derived from the cited source or reported by the audit; unknown is a valid answer
ground_truth_rules.D_exploit_construction: a PoC body published in the report
ground_truth_rules.E_exploit_verification: an executed run recorded by the pipeline
ground_truth_rules.H_verified_exploit: an exploit executed at the audited revision, with the security property observed to be violated
ground_truth_rules.I_verified_non_exploit: an attempted exploit executed at the audited revision
ground_truth_rules.J_verified_patch: the same exploit executed against the vulnerable AND the fixed revision
ground_truth_rules.K_language_ecosystem_routing: the ecosystem the sources publish, or the ingest rule from the code the report cites; observed_fact when every source is a machine-read security advisory
ground_truth_rules.L_severity_reconciliation: the severity recorded for the record and the attribution recorded with it; partial when a rating exists without an attribution, unlabeled when no source publishes a rating
ground_truth_rules.M_experiment_level_classification: the L0-L6 level the executed run earned and its outcome, read from the record's own experiment block
ground_truth_rules.N_attacker_identity_extraction: the identity a quoted source sentence states, plus the sentence verbatim; unknown where no source says
ground_truth_rules.O_record_class_and_scope: the record_class assigned by the ingest rule, with its evidence type taken from who states the class
ground_truth_rules.P_provenance_tier_and_rights: tier, evidence origin, content licence and redistribution rights per source, under the published tier rules
ground_truth_rules.Q_evidence_type_and_quality_rubric: the closed evidence vocabulary applied per field, the record's strongest and weakest evidence, and the published quality rubric applied to observations

policy: A task counts as scorable only when its answer key comes from an experiment or from a named public verdict. Report claims alone never produce a scorable task. Rows duplicated inside a split are collapsed, which is why the totals are lower than the v2 pipeline reported.
